AT Proto Stuff

June 2026

A place to collect AT Protocol notes, etc...

Notes

  • Used https://pdsls.dev/ to log into my data on the Bluesky PDS and add a Standard.site publication record.

    It's at:

    https://pdsls.dev/at://did:plc:hehia4csii5iipebsgolxxal/site.standard.publication/3mp5l453r552a

  • The TID portion (which is rkey in the standard site docs) must be 13 characters. I added a tid = "xxxxxxxxxxxxx" field to the TOML frontmatter of my content files.

  • The rust crate I ended up using is: atrium_api
